_comment: Input for cases/fin_test_3/sweep_layups.py. A TaperDesign 'base' plus 'axes' whose Cartesian product is the grid. Each axis key is a top-level design field (core, skins, pad_order, core_center) or 'pads.<ZONE>'. PlySpec is [material, angle_deg]; thickness comes from the shop inventory. Symmetric by construction: core and each pad half-stack are mirrored about the mid-plane.
